note: Jalur masuk notice dari REP/REPCCS dengan validasi subscription key dari Key Vault dan pipeline pembuatan notice sendiri. Tidak ada di chunk OCMS4.1-4.5; kemungkinan dicakup story epic REPCCS (belum dicek). Mungkin juga kanal untuk operator EPS di OCMS4.2, tapi itu cannot verify from repo.
note_en: Notice intake from REP/REPCCS with subscription key validation from Key Vault and its own notice creation pipeline. Not in chunk OCMS4.1-4.5; probably covered by a story in the REPCCS epic (not checked). It may also be the channel for the EPS operators in OCMS4.2, but that cannot be verified from the repo.

note: Report on-demand untuk notice dari CES dan REPCCS (bukan PLUS/OCMS yang dibahas OCMS4.5). Tidak ada story di chunk ini; belum dicek apakah dicakup story epic lain (misalnya CES/REPCCS).
note_en: On-demand report for notices from CES and REPCCS (not the PLUS/OCMS one discussed in OCMS4.5). No story in this chunk; whether another epic story (for example CES/REPCCS) covers it has not been checked.

feature: Upload XLSX bulk create notice di Staff Portal (template download + upload)
note: Jalur pencatatan staf lewat file XLSX memakai staff-create-notice yang sama dengan OCMS4.4. Story OCMS4.4 hanya menyebut pencatatan offence tanpa menyebut bulk upload; tiket OCMS-DF-2026-188 (template tidak bisa diunduh) menyangkut jalur ini.
note_en: Staff recording through an XLSX file uses the same staff-create-notice as OCMS4.4. The OCMS4.4 story mentions recording offences but not bulk upload; ticket OCMS-DF-2026-188 (template cannot be downloaded) concerns this path.
